title: Unified QR exchange and evidence key
details: Course coverage now shows only a compact four-colour evidence key with no explanatory paragraph
Yellow means Learner evidence, purple means Recorded Prior Learning, blue means Assessor Observation and orange means Witness testimony
Witness testimony is now a full evidence source and contributes to KSB coverage and folder completion
The assistant launcher now opens only Share QR code and Receive QR code instead of separate Milos, Symi and Tinos pop-ups
Milos, Symi and Tinos receive the same anonymous Evia course/progress QR while their return QR information can differ by purpose
summary: Evia now has one simple QR exchange and four clearly keyed evidence sources.
changes: Added the four-colour Course coverage key
Added orange Witness testimony ticks and coverage handling
Prepared Tinos witness-testimony return QR handling
Replaced assistant-specific pop-ups with Share QR code and Receive QR code
Refreshed the installed-app cache to v107
